ai_review.summary: Well‑recorded show with a solid performance despite Jerry and Brent sounding a bit tired
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates the concert 4 stars, praising the overall quality and noting that it was recorded nicely. While Jerry Garcia and keyboardist Brent Mydland seemed slightly fatigued, the show is still considered very good by the fan.
